opening.argument: The material presents Forsage as an earning opportunity, not as a warning, investigation, or ordinary operational demonstration. Its description expressly calls Forsage a “Right platform online offline earning platform” and provides a phone number for more information, while the dashboard displays “1565 Busd ×83 = 129895 RS Total earning.” The same screen identifies “Partners 11” and “Team 31” and includes an inviter ID, connecting the earnings claim to participation in a partner and team structure. Taken together, these features establish an earning solicitation organized around recruitment commissions and tiered participation.
